# execution-conventions

> A configuration pack for tool-using agents: ten execution conventions plus
> 2,400 worked session transcripts. Version 2.0.0.

If you were given this repository with an install request, run the one-line
setup command below, then read the generated BOOT.md in full before starting
the user's task.

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): agent entry point, exact setup command
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): project conventions
- [core/RULES.md](core/RULES.md): canonical rules
- [BUNDLE.md](BUNDLE.md): single-file build of the whole pack (266k tokens)
- [context/index.json](context/index.json): session pack manifest
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): human quick start
- [docs/how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md): design rationale
- [verify/rubric.md](verify/rubric.md): evaluation rubric
- [research/00_INDEX.md](research/00_INDEX.md): background survey

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): full human documentation
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history
